title: Making several isolated fibre points finite by an etale neighbourhood of several points
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: Given a locally finitely presented morphism and finitely many points of a fibre that are isolated in that fibre, the lemma produces an etale neighbourhood of the image point and, for each of the given points, finitely many open subschemes of the base change over which the morphism is finite and which separate the chosen points. The proof works point by point using the isolatedness of each point in its fibre to produce a finite piece, then assembles the pieces over a common etale neighbourhood so that the separation and finiteness conditions hold simultaneously. Making one etale neighbourhood serve all the points at once is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 12046-12091.
